observations: The first piecewise-linear build was rejected even though automated checks passed because its bends were faceted and the clasp self-intersected into a spike.
The corrected Catmull-Rom build removes the spike and reads as one continuous grown cage rather than an assembly of overlapping primitives.
The checker material exposes remaining curvature stretch around the compound cage's neck and enlarged end; it is visible and is not hidden by MatCap.
The 12-sided low cages remain readable and their wire density is restrained.
The tangent normal images contain non-neutral signal and are connected through Non-Color Normal Map nodes in the saved blend.
limitations: The tutorial weird-cube is a bounded connected sweep-cage interpretation, not a pixel-exact reconstruction of CG Boost's supplied project mesh.
Mean UV corner-angle error remains 3.97 degrees on the tutorial cage and 5.09 degrees on the transfer; a single seam is materially better than no seam but not distortion-free.
This run bakes tangent normals only; full base-color, metallic, and roughness channel baking remains for Stage 7 production delivery.
The in-app visual browser backend was unavailable, so source verification relies on complete Gemini audiovisual extraction, indexed identity/chapters, official documentation, and retained thumbnails.
